title: GOOD 2026
tagline: The global community conference of users and developers of Open OnDemand
location: University of Utah, Salt Lake City
hero_image_alt: The University Guest House and Conference Center at the University of Utah, with the Wasatch Range behind it
overview: GOOD 2026 brought the global Open OnDemand community to Salt Lake City for four days of talks, tutorials, birds-of-a-feather sessions, and hands-on work with the core team.

The conference opened with a Contributor Jam on March 9, followed by tutorials on the morning of March 10 and the main conference through March 12. Conference topics included AI and OOD, cloud integration, apps and the Appverse, OOD for education, client impacts, security and data privacy, customizations, and core development.

accessibility: The Global Open OnDemand Conference values disability and supports accessibility. The conference welcomes individuals with disabilities and encourages participants to request reasonable accommodations. Requests for event accommodations or questions about accessibility went to info@good.openondemand.org.
Requests for Sign Language interpreters and/or CART providers were asked for at least two weeks in advance where possible, subject to availability.
code_of_conduct: Attendees were subject to the NumFOCUS Code of Conduct. The conference valued the participation of each attendee and expected everyone to show respect and courtesy to one another.
